🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Küche (In the kitchen)

die Pfanne = pan
das Geschirr = dishes
die Küche = kitchen
der Kühlschrank = refrigerator
der Herd = stove
der Teller = plate

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
